verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX 5080 page makes only a general claim that RTX 50 Series GPUs boost video editing, 3D rendering and graphic design, and mentions AI-accelerated ComfyUI image/video workflows and AI-enhanced livestream voice and video. The pack never documents the hardware media engines or any certified driver track, so creator-app acceleration is claimed only at a marketing level. Missing for 10: documentation of AV1/HEVC hardware encoders and decoders (NVENC/NVDEC), named creator-app integrations, Studio or ISV-certified driver support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of creator performance.
